verdict.rationale: The product's own homepage says it can 'add a start and end time to each word in the transcript,' which is exactly the per-word positional mapping the story asks for. Results are returned as JSON by default, which suits programmatic use. The evidence is a single marketing line, so depth is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: API docs naming the request parameter that enables word timestamps, a documented JSON output schema showing per-word start/end fields, and independent or hands-on confirmation of timestamp accuracy.
